objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-27 on the not-all-equal layer referee's counterexample (a three-knot ring grows a fourth knot; three readings on disjoint distinctions take seven of eight triples, needing all four laws): (1) across the three symmetric choices of reading, does anything in the growth single one out; (2) does the bond pass the knot test with the readings as its distinctions, and is any reading read at a single knot; (3) does it iterate: after further rounds do such bonds share readings and bind one layer up, and does it happen on sampled starts; (4) the same search of carriers using shared distinctions under parity. Say which rung each reaches. Found by the referee after the advisor and the study both predicted none.
title: The bond a grown ring makes under not-all-equal: chosen or selected, a knot, and does it iterate?
